targets.description: List of SNMP queries in format [community@]iprange[:port]:oid[/id] or walk/additional variants; required to specify at least one target query. Example: public@10.0.0.1:.1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0 or 192.168.1.0/24:.1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0* (walk). Must use IP addresses, no FQDNs. See EXAMPLES section of man page for details.

community.description: Default SNMP community string for queries where not explicitly specified in target.

use_snmpv2c.description: Claim to be an SNMPv2c agent instead of SNMPv1 (braa option: -2).

verbose.description: Show short summary after doing all queries (braa option: -v).

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for responses (braa option: -t <s>). Must be positive integer or float; default: 5.

per_packet_delay.description: Microseconds to wait after sending each packet (braa option: -d <s>). Must be non-negative integer.

inter_pass_delay.description: Milliseconds between subsequent passes (braa option: -p <s>). Must be non-negative integer.

max_time.description: Quit after <s> seconds regardless of progress (braa option: -a <s>). 0 means no limit.

retries.description: Retry count per query (braa option: -r <rc>). Default: 3.

query_file.description: Path to file containing one query per line. Overrides in-line targets if present. Optional.
